title: Wait records
description: waits.json (data folder root): the helper's bookkeeping of what each ticket waits on, who was told and which reminders are due. Type WaitsFile in src/helper/waits.ts (WaitRecord, ReminderStep). Written by WaitStore.save on every change (JSON with 1-space indent, final newline, fixed waits.json.tmp then rename); read once at start by WaitStore.load, which drops records without string board and ticketId and fills missing record fields; a file it can't read is renamed waits.json.corrupt-<ms>. firstSummaryPending is written once a file was loaded (as a boolean) or the flag was set; a fresh file lacks it. WaitStore.load rebuilds the top level from these four keys, so other top-level keys are lost on the next write today; unknown record fields survive. Unknown fields inside records must be kept.

records.description: WaitRecord by its key: "<board>/<ticket>|<identity>", or "<key>#<since>" for a closed record that came back. Closed records are kept 7 days.

notifyUserAt.description: notify_user's per-ticket limit: when each "<board>/<ticket>" last reached the user (epoch ms).

firstSummaryPending.description: Seeded records not yet named in any message: the helper's first summary takes them.

key.description: Equals the record's key in records.

question.description: The question text (one per line), Claude's message, or the attention label.

label.description: The attention label when it started, e.g. "Answer 2 questions".

queuedAt.description: When the board opened this record.

remindersStopped.description: got-it, not-urgent, opened, answered, expired, off, deleted.
